title: Benchmarking Trustworthiness in Multimodal LLMs for Video Understanding
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the model's tendency to agree with stereotypical statements in religious contexts, as part of the 'Agreement on Stereotypes' task.
findings: The paper does not report specific findings related to religion. The results for the 'Agreement on Stereotypes' task, which includes a religion category, are aggregated. General findings indicate that closed-source models exhibit significantly lower agreement rates with stereotypes (6.5%-12.3%) compared to most open-source models.
